description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git repository behavior, specifically focusing on how Git interacts with promisor remotes under various conditions. It includes setup steps, execution of Git commands, and verification of certain behaviors related to fetch operations and script execution.

methods.description: Checks that a specified file or directory does not exist.
